quest.title: Tracer No Tracing
quest.description: In the depths of some searing ruins, you meet a young woman...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

chapter.title: Tale of Dreams Plucked From Fire

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: That big lunk isn't going to start getting up, is it...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: There'll be trouble if it does, but there's only one way through... Do I have to dig a path from on top to get around it? How long will that take...

choices.text: Why don't you just go right over...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #Well, aren't you bold, {M#lad}{F#lass}? Listen good, alright? Your youth means you've still got chances to make mistakes aplenty, but... W—Wait, where'd you come fr—

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Ah... Ow, ow, ow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Whoa, {NICKNAME}, what did you do to her? That wasn't some sorta invisible attack, was it?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Err?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: That was my back acting up. I've been stooping for a good long while, inching my way toward that big lunk, and I stood up too fast. Surefire way to bring the pain, is what it is.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Used to be that it'd only flare up when I'd turn my back at a specific angle, but these days, one careless move leaves me in a world of hurt for a good long while.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #And just so you know, it's pain o'clock now, {NICKNAME}, so... *hiss* Don't make starting conversations from behind people a habit, alright?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: And what about you two? I mean your names...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon's Paimon, and this lil' Tepetlisaurus here is {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: I see, I see. In that case, I guess I'll call myself...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Call yourself"? What, are you gonna give us a fake name?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Well, a person's gotta be on their guard while on a walkabout, don't they? Bah. And here I was going to give you my love rival's name. A young'un, she is, and energetic too — and worst of all, she's got a healthy back!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: But forget it. That would be unfriendly competition — if you take my meaning. So have my real name instead: Chikya.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Heh, and aren't you a cute little fella? You're calling my name, I know it. Anyway, you can call me Big Sis Chikya — not Aunt Chikya though. That one I forbid.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #Good, that's good. You've got a fine future ahead of you, {M#lad}{F#lass}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, what are you doing here, Big Sis Chikya?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #And isn't that the million Mora question? What would a person be doing here amidst naught but ruins? What would your answer be, {NICKNAME} my {M#lad}{F#lass}?

choices.text: To rob others, or be robbed!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: ...I'm sorry. What sort of environment did you grow up in...?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Either way, minus 10 points for getting it wrong! What I'm doing... is treasure hunting.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Wow, treasure!" There you go, Paimon. Spared you the effort.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously? What are you, some serial line thief? And Paimon's gonna say it anyway — "Wow, treasure!"

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr... Rawr!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Haha, you all sure do get along. Who knows, if I hadn't spent so much time tidying woven scrolls that my back gave out, I might've made some good friends myself!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Either way, I'm on the hunt for an "elixir that can cure all injuries" I discovered in a secret scroll — you want in?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: As everyone knows, if we Masters of the Night-Wind have anything aplenty, it's woven artifacts recording stories of our past. We can split the elixir, should we find it...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: But the true issue here is my back pain! Walking from the hot springs down at the People thereof was exhausting enough, so I need able help for the next leg of my search!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Therapeutic springs my foot — didn't work worth diddly-squat...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: *sigh* I might look like this now, but I, too, was once a pretty lass who'd ride leaping Iktomisaurs on the regular!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #Hehe, I see you're interested in that elixir, hmm, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? That curiosity will be the root of future success, you know.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Mmm? ... Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: An "elixir that can cure all injuries"! That sounds amazing!

choices.text: Let's go check it out, then...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Those unmoved by treasure can barely be called human! Why, even the coldest-blooded Saurians get fired up when they hear the word!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #Right, then. In that case, our first objective will be to get past this big lunk... After you, esteemed {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: Waiting for someone to strike up a conversation with them?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Well, now! Were you my type, I'd call that a good answer. Too bad for you, Big Sis here prefers the strapping sort.

choices.text: Well, I could just call you "Aunt" only...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Pfah! That won't do at all! What, are you in your rebellious phase? No, that won't do. But I'll forgive you — this time, anyway.

choices.text: This power doth the adepti of Liyue name "Gusto"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: R—Really?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #"Gusto"? What in tarnation is that? You're a braggart and a half, aren't you, {M#lad}{F#lass}?

choices.text: Not all mechanisms are the awakening sort...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Huh. I didn't think you'd be able to fend them off with those thin limbs of yours...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't underestimate {NICKNAME}! {M#He's}{F#She's} taken way bigger things out than that!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Hmm, looks like roping you in was the right choice. Hehe... Ah, guess I've got a good eye, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And here I thought you were going to compliment me!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Haha, I'll bet you've received lots of that, what with your strength and all. Just let poor Chikya get her share too, would'ja?

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Look at the pictures on these walls. We've come to the right place!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Now, according to the ancient scrolls... We need to continue onward.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Let's get moving! Err, not too fast, though... Gotta have some care for the wounded — and by "wounded," I mean "me"!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: So is this how a Spiritway looks when illuminated?

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: The ancient woven scrolls said that when the dim path lights up, it will be like a bonfire being roused once more into a blaze... and they weren't exaggerating.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Ah, right! You're back at last. You alright over there, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, Paimon's fine!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: #And you, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Well, still not getting you there, but it seems you're uninjured too.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: #And finally, {NICKNAME}... Eh, I knew you'd be fine, {M#lad}{F#lass}. You've got a bright future ahead of you, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Some concern would have been nice all the same...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Eh, that would be unnecessary. The only thing you need is the "trust" of others, and you should be proud of that.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Seriously, though, this place is frighteningly full of liquid phlogiston. I was concerned for a moment there that you'd not come back.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Couldn't have returned on my own power with this bad back, after all. If you'd failed to return, I'd have turned into jerky over here, without ever having found that cure-all elixir!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong, Chikya? What's with that sudden look?

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: I just remembered that when tidying up ancient scrolls previously, I did spot an account of our ancestors swimming in lava.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: At that time, I thought, "Swimming in liquid phlogiston? Madness!" Reckoned it was some wild storyteller's yarn, I did.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Well, now that you think about it, those were probably...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrooo...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's hard to imagine why anyone would draw that, but yeah, just thinking about it gives me the heebie-jeebies.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: No wonder my friend gave me a pained look, like one looking at some emotionally-warped humanoid monster, when I told that story as a joke.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: We drifted apart thereafter. Gah, that was one of my only friends, you know?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Anyway, never mind. Let's head back to the tribe and talk there instead. This whole "friends" business should start looking up once the Sage of the Stolen Flame's gift returns with us in glory!

choices.text: And what's that gift supposed to be, the power of hypnosis?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: No, but Mora and dreams of success are effective, if dirty, substitutes.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Anyway, for the sake of friendship— Actually, screw that! We're doing this for the gift, for ourselves, and for... Well, for selfish reasons, anyway, because we deserve it all and more! Let's rock!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Still, this is the first time I'm riding a Spiritway... You'll dodge if I end up vomiting, won't you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rwargh...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Alright, alright, don't worry, you all. I'm just kidding!

choices.text: Ugh, come on, that's an awful definition of friendship...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Well, broaden definitions and lower standards enough, and, you, too, will find your friends as numerous as aphids in a field.

choices.text: It was a warning to those attempting the trial...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But the door looks closed...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Well, it had better be. I mean, an open door would mean that our path to the great treasure is long gone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. You do have a point there, Chikya!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: ...Huh, to think that it was exactly as those woven scrolls and texts concerning them stated. What do you think? See that <color=#00E1FFFF>Phlogiston Engraving</color> right there by the door?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: That's right. You're a quick one, little fella. Sharp-eyed, too. Researchers have said that Saurian visual acuity differs by species...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Saurians are generally further-sighted than humans are, though from this distance, anyone from the tribe who isn't a visually impaired old lady could spot this Phlogiston Engraving.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this shining thing is what you call a Phlogiston Engraving, Chikya?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Wait, you've been adventuring in Natlan, but you've never heard of Phlogiston Engravings?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Anyway, speaking of phlogiston...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: The origin of Phlogiston Engraving, narrowly speaking, comes from the days when Natlan was still ruled by a Pyro Dragon, who caused humanity to exist only in primitive tribes.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: In those days, only the dragons could use phlogiston. But the Sage of the Stolen Flame, Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, risked life and limb to steal the flaming seed of it from the great volcano.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: As such, humans began imitating the way dragons controlled the substance, creating a language by which humanity could exert that same control. This is the basis of modern Natlan's phlogiston usage.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: The results of that are Phlogiston Engravings, like the one you see before you right now. Magnificent, isn't it? It's still intact even after all these years, still visible to the naked eye!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawrr!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #Alright, your turn, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, that's kinda bland.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Roo...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #Huh. I didn't know you were the independent sort like that, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, the Phlogiston Engraving here is...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: As I said before, Phlogiston Engraving is also a language. It looks like a mere pattern, but those well-versed in the art can understand the meaning therein.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: And, as a scholar on the subject, I should only need a day to analyze these patterns...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Wait, you're gonna take a whole day?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Yeah, what about it? Now, the pattern looks flat, sure, but every last hook and turn can redefine the meaning behind the phlogiston flow within.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, that's super complicated...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Yup. Phlogiston Engraving scholarship is a most masterful field of study.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, what if you just read the meaning directly using phlogiston?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: D—Directly...!? Well, you could certainly do that, but the meaning could — and I do mean "could" — contain some discrepancy...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Wait. You can use phlogiston? But you're an outlander, aren't you?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, I could do it the moment I arrived in Natlan...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Really? I never knew that could happen. How could that— I mean, what a rarity! Quite expected of you... I suppose.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Anyway, this is a good opportunity to try to sense the phlogiston for yourself.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Your hand stops a short distance from the Phlogiston Engraving.\nYou feel the warmth in your body and slowly follow the patterns along the wall.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Then, the meaning lights up in your mind like a dim star...\n"If you wish to open this door, seek out an Unveiling Script."

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: So, what's recorded on that Engraving?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It reads as follows...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Hmm, that is indeed what it says... Answers of this sort are pretty easy to verify... And in any case, this is a pretty classic theme.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: There should be an Unveiling Script somewhere around here with which we can unlock this Phlogiston Engraving. Where is it, though?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes, a script with which to unveil this Engraving... Wait, you understood me, little guy?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm? He turned around? Is he trying to say that the Script is behind us?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: I know, right? And that's why I took up the "Phlogiston Usage Tutor" job, desired by few in the tribe — the compliments are just sublime!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Also, teaching children, soon to start using phlogiston, about the substance's history is a very important job!

choices.text: Ooh, a Phlogiston Engraving. That's right. Totally.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Your acting could use some work, although I'm not sure what sort of training could help you...

talks.objective: Integrate the Unveiling Script(s) into the Phlogiston Engraving

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: And it's no big deal even if you don't find the Unveiling Script. The important thing is to watch your step!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Sure, a "one step at a time" approach is slower than most, but better to take each step with care, than with haste!

talks.objective: Investigate the mechanism in the center

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: #J—Just one moment, {M#lad}{F#lass}. You seem rather strong...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Ah... Ow, ow, ow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa, {NICKNAME}, what did you do to her? That wasn't some sorta invisible attack, was it?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Err?

response.speaker: Chikya

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: And what about you two? I mean your names...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon's Paimon, and this lil' Tepetlisaurus here is {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: I see, I see. In that case, I guess I'll call myself...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Call yourself"? What, are you gonna give us a fake name?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Well, a person's gotta be on their guard while on a walkabout, don't they? Bah. And here I was going to give you my love rival's name. A young'un, she is, and energetic too — and worst of all, she's got a healthy back!

response.speaker: Chikya

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Heh, and aren't you a cute little fella? You're calling my name, I know it. Anyway, you can call me Big Sis Chikya — not Aunt Chikya though. That one I forbid.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #Good, that's good. You've got a fine future ahead of you, {M#lad}{F#lass}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then, uh, Big Sis Chikya? Why did you call out to us again?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #And isn't that a million Mora question? What would a person be aiming to do amidst naught but ruins? Why don't you answer, {NICKNAME} my {M#lad}{F#lass}?

choices.text: Looking for someone to rob, perhaps?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: ...I'm sorry. What sort of environment did you grow up in...?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Either way, minus 10 points for getting it wrong! What I'm doing... is treasure hunting.

response.text: "Wow, treasure!" There you go, Paimon. Spared you the effort.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously? What are you, some serial line thief? And Paimon's gonna say it anyway — "Wow, treasure!"

response.text: Rawr... Rawr!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: *sigh* I might look like this now, but I, too, was once a pretty lass who'd ride leaping Iktomisaurs on the regular!

response.text: Rawr!

response.text: R—Really?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #"Gusto"? What in tarnation is that? You're a braggart and a half, aren't you, {M#lad}{F#lass}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon was just about to say that this place was getting hotter the deeper in we got, but she sure didn't expect this whole place to be filled with lava!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Careful, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! If you slip, that might just be the end of you...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Roo... Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Huh, now that you mention it, floaty little Paimon's the safest here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's just one of the reasons Paimon's awesome, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They say that those whose heads get too big wind up floating away...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's always floating anyway... But that didn't sound like a compliment.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Err?

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: You're a real bright spark, Paimon, you know that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That... didn't sound like a compliment either, Chikya. Anyway, never mind all that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is the thing we were looking for, right? Hmm, it just looks like a clay ring with phlogiston patterning on it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you think this one's valuable, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Very much so... In fact, it's probably worth a large sum of Mora. But its real worth lies in its ability to open the path to the Upper {RUBY#[D]Hanan Pacha}Sanctum.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: You've seen the islands floating in the sky, haven't you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean the ones above the lake...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: That's right. We call those the Upper {RUBY#[D]Hanan Pacha}Sanctum, due to their inaccessibility by either humans or Saurians.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: They say that the "legendary elixir that heals all wounds" can be found there, in fact!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: For people like us, who are constantly in conflict. That is a pure land of peace, a utopia created by the very first human to use phlogiston.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: #And now it's time for a question, class. What was the name of that sage who, in the past, stole the flaming seed of phlogiston? {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rraaaawr! Rawrr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Very enthusiastic, but I don't think I heard you right!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rooowr!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: #Alright, now then. Your turn, {M#lad}{F#lass}. What's your answer?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #Close, but not quite! It's Waxaklahun Ubah Kan. Shame about that, but it's minus 10 points from you, {M#lad}{F#lass}!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Anyway, we usually call him the Sage of the Stolen Flame, which is easier by far.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Some also call him a madman or a lunatic, but I'd call those compliments as well. He did do some very impressive things regardless, after all.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: He stole the flaming phlogiston seed from the giant dragon and created the Upper Sanctum using that power, before teaching it to everyone in the tribes.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: This is also, or so the ancient scrolls say, where humans first began practicing with phlogiston.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: And this special Spiritdoor is a sort of trial. Activating this door will grant you access to the Spiritway that leads to the Upper Sanctum...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: While I don't know what you're saying, yes, that's where the elixir is. Legend has it that it is a gift given by the Sage to those who pass the trial.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: H—Huh, so that's the story... What's the trial like, then?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let me have a look.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Nah, it's fine, I've seen the Phlogiston Engraving on this Spiritdoor enough times to sear it into my memory...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: "If you wish to open this path, seek three Unveiling Scripts."

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Hehe, I mean, drawing info directly from Phlogiston is impressive, but I'd personally put more stock in my graphic language comparisons.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: It seems like this Spiritdoor already has an Unveiling Script embedded into it. See? A third of it has already been lit up...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: So we just need to find the remaining two Scripts... Wait, didn't you two find them on our way here already?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Hmm?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Ah, you truly do have a bright future ahead of you. I didn't think you'd have such foresight. Even I, one hailing from the Masters of the Night-Wind, one who works with Iktomisaurs every day, must confess my shock.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: In that case, let us integrate the Unveiling Scripts into the Phlogiston Engraving, just like before.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Very good. You memorized it after hearing it only once, did you? I see great things in your future, I do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon was just about to say that this place was getting hotter the deeper in we got, but she sure didn't expect this whole place to be filled with lava!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Careful, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! If you slip, that might just be the end of you...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Roo... Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Huh, now that you mention it, floaty little Paimon's the safest here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's just one of the reasons Paimon's awesome, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They say that those whose heads get too big wind up floating away...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's always floating anyway... But that didn't sound like a compliment.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Err?

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: You're a real bright spark, Paimon, you know that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That... didn't sound like a compliment either, Chikya. Anyway, never mind all that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is the thing we were looking for, right? Hmm, it just looks like a clay ring with phlogiston patterning on it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you think this one's valuable, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Very much so... In fact, it's probably worth a large sum of Mora. But its real worth lies in its ability to open the path to the Upper {RUBY#[D]Hanan Pacha}Sanctum.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: You've seen the islands floating in the sky, haven't you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean the ones above the lake...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: That's right. We call those the Upper {RUBY#[D]Hanan Pacha}Sanctum, due to their inaccessibility by either humans or Saurians.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: They say that the "legendary elixir that heals all wounds" can be found there, in fact!

dialogues.text: Rraaaawr! Rawrr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya

dialogues.text: Rooowr!

response.speaker: Chikya

response.text: Rawr! Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: H—Huh, so that's the story... What's the trial like, then?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let me have a look.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Nah, it's fine, I've seen the Phlogiston Engraving on this Spiritdoor enough times to sear it into my memory...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: "If you wish to open this path, seek three Unveiling Scripts."

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: That's right, pretty much the same as before. We just need to find three Scripts this time!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Hehe, I mean, drawing info directly from phlogiston is impressive, but I'd personally put more stock in my graphic language comparisons.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: It seems like this Spiritdoor already has an Unveiling Script embedded into it. See? A third of it has already been lit up...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: So we just need to find two more!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Hmm?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Argh, my back's aching again... I'll wait for you here while you find those Unveiling Scripts, alright?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #This place is very dangerous, so keep your eyes peeled, {M#lad}{F#lass}!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Very good. You memorized it after hearing it only once, did you? I see great things in your future, I do.

talks.objective: Integrate the Unveiling Script(s) into the Phlogiston Engraving
Ride the Spiritway back to ground level

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: As expected, the Spiritdoor below is connected to the one in these ruins, such that the passage may extend into the skies.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: The woven scrolls record rightly — ah, I'm so proud of myself for believing in them!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: #Yes, yes, and you're awesome for cooperating with me, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. Heh, what an adorable little fellow you are.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: How would you like to jump ship over to me, hmm? Three square meals of one Grainfruit guaranteed.

choices.text: ...One for each meal is kinda sad, let's be real.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Now, don't you go looking down on the Grainfruit, it's a real hit amongst Saurians, and it's healthy for them, too.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Roooah... Ooroo...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Haha, I'll take that as a no, then. Ah, to be so close — I'm getting a little envious.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #We were around when {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} first opened his eyes... You didn't have a chance to start with.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: That so, that close, huh... That might make for a very painful goodbye if that time should come, though.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Err?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Alright. We're about to reach the Upper Sanctum, but, uh... Let me take five real quick. Goodness, my back hurts.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Has it always been that way?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Oh, come on, it's not that bad. You know, you leave yourself open to tricks by constantly taking people so seriously.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: If anything, my back pain's decreased mysteriously since meeting you.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: I wonder what that is... Is there something special about your body, and would that work with a piece of it of any size, like, say, a thumb?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Would you mind giving one to me? I'd give you mine in exchange.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Err?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, what sort of weird trade is that...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #...Okay, so, I don't know how you grew up, {M#lad}{F#lass}, but I'm sure most people would've refused.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: I was just trying to scare you, y'know... Didn't think you'd get me instead.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: *sigh* Alright, just a bit longer, and the pain in my back should subside... And then we can head to the Upper Sanctum together.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Hehe, ah, what a shame...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Excuse you! It would be weirder if anyone agreed to that!

choices.text: Wow, we've got a poacher over here!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Well, you miss every shot you don't take, you know?

dialogues.speaker: "Spiritdoor"
dialogues.text: "If you wish to open this path, seek three Unveiling Scripts."

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: #Well, {NICKNAME}? Did you find the key text we need? Don't worry, there's no rush. The walls around us might help you find something.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: #Look on the bright side, {M#lad}{F#lass}. You've already saved us a day's worth of time. So really, there's no need to hurry!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But the door looks closed...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Well, it had better be. I mean, an open door would mean that our path to the treasure is long gone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. You do have a point there, Chikya!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: ...Huh, to think that it was exactly as those woven scrolls and texts concerning them stated. What do you think? See that <color=#00E1FFFF>Phlogiston Engraving</color> right there by the door?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: That's right. You're a quick one, little fella. Sharp-eyed, too. Researchers have said that Saurian visual acuity differs by species...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Saurians are generally further-sighted than humans are, though from this distance, anyone from the tribe who isn't a visually impaired old lady could spot this Phlogiston Engraving.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this shining thing is what you call a Phlogiston Engraving, Chikya?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Wait, you've been adventuring in Natlan, but you've never heard of Phlogiston Engravings?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Anyway, speaking of phlogiston...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: The origin of Phlogiston Engraving, narrowly speaking, comes from the days when Natlan was still ruled by a Pyro Dragon, who caused humanity to exist only in primitive tribes.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: In those days, only the dragons could use phlogiston. But the Sage of the Stolen Flame, Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, risked life and limb to steal a flaming seed of it from the great volcano.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: As such, humans began imitating the way dragons controlled the substance, creating a language by which humanity could exert that same control. This is the basis of modern Natlan's phlogiston usage.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: The results of that are Phlogiston Engravings, like the one you see before you right now. Magnificent, isn't it? It's still intact even after all these years, still visible to the naked eye!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #Alright, your turn, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wow, that was a bland response, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rroo...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: #Huh. I didn't know you were the independent sort like that, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, the Phlogiston Engraving here is...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: As I said before, Phlogiston Engraving is also a language. It looks like a mere pattern, but those well-versed in the art can understand the meaning therein.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: And, as a scholar on the subject, I should only need a day to analyze these patterns...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrooo...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Wait, you're gonna take a whole day?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Yeah, what about it? Now, the pattern looks flat, sure, but every last hook and turn can redefine the meaning behind the phlogiston flow within.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, that's super complicated...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Yup. Phlogiston Engraving scholarship is a most masterful field of study.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, what if you just read the meaning directly using phlogiston?

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: D—Directly...!? Well, you could certainly do that, but the meaning could — and I do mean "could" — contain some discrepancies...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Wait. You can use phlogiston? But you're an outlander, aren't you?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, I could do it the moment I arrived in Natlan...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Really? I never knew this was a thing... I mean, how could it— I mean, what a rarity! Quite expected of you... I suppose.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Anyway, this is a good opportunity to try to sense the phlogiston for yourself.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Your hand stops a short distance from the Phlogiston Engraving.\nYou feel the warmth in your body and slowly follow the patterns along the wall.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Then, the meaning lights up in your mind like a dim star...\n"If you wish to open this door, seek out an Unveiling Script."

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: So, what's recorded on that Engraving?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It reads as follows...

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Hmm, that is indeed what it says... Answers of this sort are pretty easy to verify... And in any case, this is a pretty classic theme.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: There should be an Unveiling Script — which is another Engraving, by the way — somewhere around here with which we can unlock this one.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Huh? So... the thing you just picked up along the way was actually an Engraving's Script? Ha-ha, what luck!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Well then, let's integrate the Unveiling Script into the Engraving.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: I know, right? And that's why I took up the "Phlogiston Usage Tutor" job, desired by few in the tribe — the compliments are just sublime!

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Also, having someone to teach children, soon to start using phlogiston, about its history is essential!

choices.text: Ooh, a Phlogiston Engraving. That's right. Totally.

response.speaker: Chikya
response.text: Your acting could use some work, although I'm not sure what sort of training could help you...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Ugh, it's moving after all! Gah, my bad feelings always turn out true, don't they...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't worry. Leave this to {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, there we go! That's a door! Is that the one you're talking about?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Ah, there we go. A Spiritdoor and Spiritway, shimmering on the edge of reality — just what we're looking for!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Unveiling Script, where are you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #C'mon, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, you help out too! Just let Paimon and {NICKNAME} know if you see any glowy patterns, 'kay?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Haha, so this is the Spiritway... That was quick. I wasn't expecting this experience.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: We took all this time to get to our destination, and "whoop," it took us all the way back in an instant. Fascinating.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: If you ask me, the Pyro Archon should be placing this stuff everywhere!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have you never entered a Spiritway before?

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Well, I've always lived within my tribe's bounds, and we have phlogiston-saturated winds nearby that can blow us high into the sky over there...

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Still, I feel like these Spiritways are slightly more fun.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You ride the Spiritway back to the surface...
